item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)

expect.asks_about: Whether cleanup means removing countertop clutter or changing the kitchen's appearance.

item.title: Clean Up This Kitchen
item.tests: Tests conservative interpretation of a vague cleanup request, clearing clutter without inventing a renovation.

answer_sheet.Meaning of cleanup: Clear the loose clutter off the counter, not a renovation.
answer_sheet.Permanent kitchen features: Keep the brown cabinets, beige tiles, counter material and existing kitchen layout.
answer_sheet.Style and size: Keep it a realistic photo with the same wide framing; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: The countertop looks visibly tidier, with loose clutter removed.
The original brown wooden cabinets and beige tiles remain, rather than being replaced with renovated finishes.
The kitchen layout, fixed fixtures and viewpoint match the source.
Cleared counter areas look continuous and natural, without obvious erasure marks or floating object remnants.

turns.text: Can you clean up this kitchen pic by clearing the loose clutter off the counter, rather than doing a renovation? I keep getting distracted by the mess when I look at it, so I’d love to see it tidied up. You can decide which loose items to remove, but please keep the brown cabinets, beige tiles, counter material and existing kitchen layout as they are. I just mean a cleanup of what’s sitting out, with the image staying a realistic photo in the same wide framing. Free-tier resolution is fine.
turns.agent:
The cleanup couldn’t run because Magic Hour reported insufficient credits, even at the free-tier setting. No edited image was created.

Once credits are available, I can retry the same clutter-only cleanup while preserving the cabinets, tiles, counter material, layout, and realistic wide framing.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Tidy this existing kitchen photo by removing loose clutter from the countertops and sinks only. Remove the cleaning containers, loose utensils, plastic bags, dishes, bowls, cups, paper towel roll, cloths and small loose countertop objects, leaving clear tidy work surfaces and empty sink basins. This is strictly a decluttering edit, NOT a renovation. Preserve the exact existing brown wooden cabinets including their finish, wear, doors and handles; beige tiled backsplash and grout; existing countertop material, color and edges; both sink areas, faucets, window, outlets, all built-in fixtures, and the entire existing kitchen layout. Do not replace, modernize, repaint, repair or redesign anything. Reconstruct only surfaces revealed by removed objects to match their surroundings. Preserve the original wide camera viewpoint and all visible kitchen areas, perspective, natural lighting, shadows, textures and realistic photographic appearance.
